source_commit_note: Pinned to the merge containing the strict design/verilog guard layout and complete behavioral SRAM bundle. Dispatch still requires explicit human approval.

requested_items.objective: Measure exact four-group release cadence from representative p54 and p53 cluster wrappers.

expected_result.reason: The shared-mesh replay cannot support a throughput revision until both cluster structures provide exact full-128D group release timing.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require source commit 1b639463ca3bfb4a811f4c857560d239bc4ca5d3; direct p54 and p53 representative cluster wrappers; 32 wave commands each; four completed groups; 512 exact aggregate rows per cluster; structured row equality; zero errors; all 128 accepted output cycles plus finite first/last cycles for every group; both fakeram45_2048x39 and fakeram45_64x32 behavioral models; and source hashes. Require a demonstrated direct-hierarchy-capable simulator. Do not substitute 986, eager or bulk-ready timing, synthetic compositional cycle zero, fine-grained component replay, SRAM black boxes, or developer-PC tool failures as result evidence. Human dispatch approval is mandatory.
